d:
Patna Protest : patna men ek bar phir chhatron ka pradarshan dekhne ko mila. bharti parikshaon men pardarshita sunishchit karne, pepar lik ke mamlon men karravaee aur pariksha prakriya ki nishpaksh janch ki mang ko lekar chhatr sarak par utre. pradarshankariyon ne daroga bharti, BSSC aur BPSC parikshaon se jure mudde uthae aur jimmedar logon par karravaee ki mang ki. aakhir chhatron ki pramukh mangen kya hain aur bharti parikshaon ko lekar unka virodh kyon jari hai? dekhie patna se yah khas riporta.
